name: Nha Trang resort living
summary: Vietnam Tourism names Vinpearl Resort and Spa Nha Trang Bay for families, on the island reached by the sea cable.
body: The city sand is the Trần Phú hotel row. The island stay the national page names is Vinpearl Resort and Spa Nha Trang Bay, with the cable crossing onto Hòn Tre. The bureau page measures that cable at 3,320 m and dates the opening to March 2007.
A room rate was not printed on the page used here. Ride minutes from Cam Ranh were not printed. The airport figures stay on the city page: 27 km on the AIP, about 30 km on Vietnam Tourism.

properties.name: Vinpearl Resort and Spa Nha Trang Bay
properties.summary: The family resort Vietnam Tourism names on the island, beside the cable crossing and VinWonders.
